name: X Stock Ledger
query:
SELECT 
    posting_date as "Date:Date:100",
    (SELECT item_name FROM `tabX Item` WHERE name = item) as "Item:Data:150",
    (SELECT warehouse_name FROM `tabX Warehouse` WHERE name = warehouse) as "Warehouse:Data:150",
    transaction_type as "Type:Data:100",
    quantity as "Quantity:Float:100"
FROM `tabX Stock Ledger Entry`
ORDER BY posting_date DESC
